name: FlutterFlow
summary: Visual development platform for Flutter apps on mobile, web and desktop, with code export.
description: FlutterFlow is a visual builder for applications based on Google's Flutter framework, targeting mobile, web and desktop. It includes AI features, templates and the option to download the generated source code. The Free plan allows building and testing up to two projects; Basic costs $39 per month with code download, and Growth costs $80 for the first seat and $55 for the second.
